verdict.rationale: Close's API documents Custom Object Types that let you create arbitrary types with user-defined fields, going beyond leads, contacts and opportunities. Custom fields are richly configurable (data type, multiplicity, edit permissions) and can be shared across objects. missing for 10: explicit evidence of relationships/links between custom objects and built-in records, depth of the custom-object docs beyond a one-line summary, independent or hands-on corroboration.
